title: Week 12 — Joinder and the assigned class-action chapter
shortTitle: Week 12 — Joinder and the assigned class-action chapter
summary: Read the entirety of Chapters 9 and 10. This week emphasizes joinder; the next emphasizes class actions. Examine the governing joinder and class-action Rules and §§ 1332(d), 1407, and 1453. Interpleader and intervention remain assigned reading although no classroom time is allocated to them.
